text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...While out on a walk, I saw Sakura 
Chiyono O with a young Umamusume. Just as 
I called out to greet her—

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: —Osu!! Master!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ossu!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, force of habit. Chiyono O, who is 
this child?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm so glad we bumped into you here, 
Yaeno-san! Looks like this girl wants to 
become your apprentice!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ever since she saw you run, Yaeno-san, 
she's looked up to you! Would you mind 
listening to her request?

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
—The secret!! Master, tell me the secret 
words! I want to know them!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying that, the child pulled out a sheet 
of paper. Apparently, they want Yaeno 
Muteki to write down her 'secret 
teachings' on it.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...I see. A single truth can become a 
guiding principle for one's training, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. While I am somewhat versed in the 
classics, and the Kongo Yaegaki style 
imparts many teachings to its 
practitioners... this is quite difficult.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
A young child is asking me earnestly. 
Rather than simply borrowing someone 
else's words, it must be something I 
truly, from the bottom of my heart, 
consider to be the ultimate secret.

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Osu!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...So cute.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Um, maybe my Chiyo-note could be of help? 
I've been on a roll lately, so I've got a 
bumper crop of maxims! I'd be happy to 
share one with you!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Mrmph... Ch-Chiyono O-san's maxim... I 
truly appreciate the sentiment, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if it was just a single phrase, once 
she started pondering it, nothing easily 
came to mind. Yaeno Muteki continued to 
agonize over it—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Hrmm. To think putting the core of the 
teachings into words would be so 
difficult... Is this due to my own lack of 
experience as well?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...? Right now, could there be anything 
more important than that?
choice_data_list:
Imparting lessons that will truly benefit 
you.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...! I see! That's precisely it...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
What is essential is not to grant "kind 
words," but to impart "good teachings"...! 
If that is so...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...And so, without writing a single 
character, Yaeno Muteki returned the paper 
to the child."

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"...I can't learn the secret technique? 
Can I not become... Master Yaeno's 
disciple...?"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...Not so. The one who should truly put 
brush to paper— is you yourself."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Record your daily efforts onto that blank 
sheet of paper. If you truly wish to be a 
runner, you must do so every day without 
fail, no matter what happens.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
As I said earlier, the Kongo Yaegaki style 
has many teachings and maxims. However, 
they are merely "signposts."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—Only those who walk the path with their 
own strength can truly bear the "fruits" 
of teaching.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
In the past, brute force was all I knew as 
well. Yet by keeping up daily training, 
bit by bit, I carved true "technique" into 
my body.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Even if it is just one small step at a 
time, only those who keep walking forward 
become the "real deal." That is what I 
learned at the dojo... and I am still in 
the middle of that journey today.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Do you understand your Master's 
intentions? My dear pupil.

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...! Osu!! Thank you very much!!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I'll train until this paper is pitch 
black... and then!! I'll come back to ask 
for your next teachings!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Indeed! Strive with all your heart!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And with a quick bow, the child ran off.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Whoaa... Amazing! That exchange truly felt 
like a master and apprentice!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...It felt presumptuous of me to act as a 
'master.' To tell the truth, I had my 
doubts... but I've changed my mind a bit."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Passing on what one has gained to the next 
generation. That alone is reason enough to 
pursue this path for a lifetime... Yes, I 
have come to realize that.
choice_data_list:
I hope we can have a master vs. student 
showdown someday.

It'd be nice to have a master vs. student 
showdown someday, wouldn't it?

...Aren't you already the real deal 
yourself?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Passing on what one has gained to the next 
generation. That alone is reason enough to 
pursue this path for a lifetime... Yes, I 
have come to realize that.
choice_data_list:
I hope we can have a master vs. student 
showdown someday.

It'd be nice to have a master vs. student 
showdown someday, wouldn't it?

...Aren't you already the real deal 
yourself?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. As long as I continue along my 
path and grow infinitely stronger, that is 
also possible.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
In truth, my grandparents only grow 
stronger with each passing year. With 
tireless training, nothing is impossible. 
The same goes for racing.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...I must move forward. Along the long, 
long road ahead.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Not at all. Rather, I believe that so long 
as I let myself think that way even for a 
moment, I cannot be called the "real 
deal."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It is precisely because you recognize your 
own inexperience that you can move forward 
beyond where you are now... This, too, is 
a secret of the craft.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
In other words... I am still very much in 
need of a "good master."
